name: Deploy Frontend

on:
  push:
    branches: ["deploy"]

jobs:
  deploy:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    env:
      AWS_REGION: us-east-1

      FRONTEND_INSTANCE_ID: i-XXXXXXXX
      # ⚠️ CAMBIAR POR EL ID REAL EC2

      FRONTEND_APP_DIR: /home/ec2-user/tutorial-frontend
      # ⚠️ CAMBIAR SI LA CARPETA EN EC2 TIENE OTRO NOMBRE

    steps:

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.aws

          cat > ~/.aws/credentials << EOF
          [default]
          aws_access_key_id=${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws_secret_access_key=${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws_session_token=${{ secrets.AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }}
          EOF

          cat > ~/.aws/config << EOF
          [default]
          region=${AWS_REGION}
          output=json
          EOF

      - name: Deploy frontend with SSM
        run: |
          aws ssm send-command \
          --region "${AWS_REGION}" \
          --document-name "AWS-RunShellScript" \
          --instance-ids "${FRONTEND_INSTANCE_ID}" \
          --parameters commands='[
            "cd ${FRONTEND_APP_DIR}",
            "docker compose pull",
            "docker compose up -d"
          ]'
